sentences.en: Mickey Conners made mincemeat of his opponent in the ring.
sentences.zh: 迈克尔·康纳在拳台上彻底击败了他的对手。

sentences.en: The communist gave in to his tough opponent at last.
sentences.zh: 这个共产主义者最终屈服于他强硬的对手。

sentences.en: We thought it wrong not to listen to our opponents.
sentences.zh: 我们认为不应忽视我们的反对意见是错误的。

senses.zh: 对手，竞争者；反对者，阻止者

mnemonic: 词根记忆：op（相反）+pon（放置）+ ent（人）→反着站的人→对手，敌手
